@B 26pn 24000
{"'Shadow Phantom Soldier' is looking for an adventurer who will do the jobs for the Shadow Phantom unit. Go check with him.": "'Shadow Phantom Soldier' sedang mencari petualang yang mau mengerjakan tugas-tugas untuk unit Shadow Phantom. Pergilah menemuinya.", "'Shadow Phantom Soldier' is looking for an adventurer who will do the quests of the Shadow Phantom unit. Go check with him.": "'Shadow Phantom Soldier' sedang mencari petualang yang mau menjalankan misi untuk unit Shadow Phantom. Pergilah menemuinya.", "...A bonus gift if I answer all the questions right?": "...Hadiah bonus kalau aku menjawab semua pertanyaan dengan benar?", "...Finally, the tutorial's finished!": "...Akhirnya, tutorialnya selesai!", "...Finding a merchant is more difficult than I thought.": "...Mencari pedagang ternyata lebih sulit dari yang kuduga.", "...Hmm. I didn't know such thing existed.": "...Hmm. Aku tak tahu hal seperti itu ada.", "...How do I do it?": "...Bagaimana cara melakukannya?", "...I see it pays to know a lot of NPCs.": "...Rupanya kenal banyak NPC itu menguntungkan.", "...I wish to learn about...": "...Aku ingin belajar tentang...", "...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.": "...Aku terharu ratu sampai memberikan perintah seperti itu.", "...Is that right? And then I'd like to learn about...": "...Begitu? Kalau begitu aku ingin belajar tentang...", "...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?": "...Shadow Phantom?;Para penjaga ratu?", "...Skill attacks?": "...Serangan skill?", "...That's fantastic!": "...Luar biasa!", "...The icon next to the number 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 slots....": "...Ikon di samping slot nomor 1, 2, 3, 4, dan 5....", "...The queen is very thoughtful!": "...Ratu sungguh perhatian!", "...There's nothing to it. But I would like to learn more....": "...Tidak sulit kok. Tapi aku ingin belajar lagi....", "...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!": "...Ini Elveland, kerajaan para Summoner! Jadi di sinilah petualanganku dimulai.;Mengasyikkan sekali!", "...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!": "...Ini Lorencia, kerajaan para Dark Wizard dan Dark Knight! Jadi di sinilah petualanganku dimulai.;Luar biasa! Petualanganku dimulai!", "...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!": "...Ini Noria, kerajaan para Elf! Jadi di sinilah petualanganku dimulai.;Mengasyikkan sekali!", "...Town Portal Scroll?": "...Town Portal Scroll?", "...Uniria?": "...Uniria?", "...Whispers...": "...Bisikan...", "...trade...": "...berdagang...", "1 million Zen for free mercenary registration and 500,000 Zen for deposit. Will you register as a free mercenary now? (Lv. 350 - Master Level)": "1 juta Zen untuk pendaftaran tentara bayaran bebas dan 500.000 Zen untuk deposit. Maukah kau mendaftar sebagai tentara bayaran bebas sekarang? (Lv. 350 - Master Level)", "10 clubs from the Burnt Murderers in Vulcanus will do. Please remember that the 'Heroes' in the Burnt Murderers don't drop the item. Come back to me with 10 Burnt Murderer's Clubs to get the reward.": "10 tongkat dari Burnt Murderers di Vulcanus sudah cukup. Ingat bahwa 'Heroes' di antara Burnt Murderers tidak menjatuhkan item tersebut. Kembalilah padaku dengan 10 Burnt Murderer's Clubs untuk menerima hadiah.", "A band going after the sealed stone is using mechanical warriors to attack our forces in Kanturu Ruins. Please defeat Splinter Wolves, which are proving to be most troublesome.": "Sekelompok yang mengincar batu perangkap menggunakan prajurit mekanik untuk menyerang pasukan kita di Kanturu Ruins. Kalahkanlah Splinter Wolves yang terbukti paling merepotkan.", "A damage and defense increase buff? That sounds great!": "Buff peningkatan damage dan pertahanan? Kedengarannya bagus!", "A fighting spirit doesn't benefit a hero. (Refuse)": "Semangat juang tidak bermanfaat bagi seorang pahlawan. (Tolak)", "A group of monsters has appeared at Dungeon Levels 2 and 3 and is attacking our reconnaissance party. I'd like to ask you, traveler, to hunt down these monsters. Will you accept this quest? (Level 131-140)": "Sekelompok monster muncul di Dungeon Level 2 dan 3 dan menyerang pasukan pengintai kita. Aku ingin memintamu, pengembara, untuk memburu monster-monster ini. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 131-140)", "A hero is only human in the end, the energy of insanity…": "Seorang pahlawan pada akhirnya hanyalah manusia biasa, energi kegilaan itu…", "A hero is relentless. I accept. (Accept)": "Seorang pahlawan tak kenal lelah. Aku terima. (Terima)", "A hero without strong mind is little better than a corpse. Please continue challenging yourself until the end.": "Pahlawan tanpa tekad yang kuat nyaris tak lebih baik dari mayat. Teruslah menantang dirimu sampai akhir.", "A moment of carelessness can spell disaster for even the most experienced warriors. I hope you'll remain committed to your training at all times. I'm charged with issuing invitations to Devil Square, an arena where you can undergo the most amount of training in the least amount of time. Would you like to hear more? (All characters: Master Level)": "Sekejap lengah bisa mendatangkan bencana bahkan bagi prajurit paling berpengalaman. Aku harap kau tetap berlatih setiap saat. Aku bertugas membagikan undangan ke Devil Square, arena tempat kau bisa berlatih sebanyak mungkin dalam waktu sesingkat mungkin. Mau mendengar lebih lanjut? (Semua karakter: Master Level)", "A rumor has it that a group of monsters is chasing after the sealed stone. The rumor also says these monsters are likely to be Ghost Napins, but no one has actually seen them in person. It may just be a rumor, but will you eliminate these Ghost Napins and protect the sealed stone?": "Kabarnya sekelompok monster mengincar batu perangkap. Kabar itu juga mengatakan monster-monster ini kemungkinan besar adalah Ghost Napins, tapi belum ada yang benar-benar melihatnya langsung. Mungkin ini cuma kabar, tapi maukah kau melenyapkan Ghost Napins ini dan melindungi batu perangkap?", "A search party dispatched to Aida reports that the number of Death Trees is rapidly increasing. Go to Aida and eliminate 50 Death Trees.": "Pasukan pengintai yang dikirim ke Aida melaporkan jumlah Death Trees meningkat pesat. Pergilah ke Aida dan lenyapkan 50 Death Trees.", "A search party that has been dispatched to Aida reports that the number of Death Trees is rapidly increasing. Go to Aida and eliminate 50 Death Trees.": "Pasukan pengintai yang telah dikirim ke Aida melaporkan jumlah Death Trees meningkat pesat. Pergilah ke Aida dan lenyapkan 50 Death Trees.", "A taint of insanity": "Noda kegilaan", "A tutorial?;I look forward to it!": "Tutorial?;Aku menantikannya!", "A wise decision. Chaos Castle is a battle field created by Lugard, the god of the heaven world, and Secrarium, the god of the underworld, for the balance of good and evil in this world. However, travelers started going to Chaos Castle and fighting on the side of Lugard, tipping the balance in disfavor of Secrarium.": "Keputusan bijak. Chaos Castle adalah medan pertempuran yang diciptakan Lugard, dewa dunia atas, dan Secrarium, dewa dunia bawah, demi keseimbangan kebaikan dan kejahatan di dunia ini. Namun, para pengembara mulai pergi ke Chaos Castle dan bertarung di pihak Lugard, sehingga keseimbangan bergeser dan merugikan Secrarium.", "A wise decision. Defeat 50 Cursed Liches in Elveland (Area 2) and 50 Yetis in Devias (Area 2). Do that, and you'll receive 60,000 EXP points, 1,500,000 Zens, and 1 Jewel of Chaos as a reward from the Shadow Phantom Soldier.": "Keputusan bijak. Kalahkan 50 Cursed Lich di Elveland (Area 2) dan 50 Yeti di Devias (Area 2). Lakukan itu, dan kau akan menerima 60.000 poin EXP, 1.500.000 Zen, dan 1 Jewel of Chaos sebagai hadiah dari Shadow Phantom Soldier.", "A wise decision. Defeat 50 Totem Golems in Elveland (Area 3) and 50 Elite Yetis in Devias (Area 3). Do that, and you'll receive 60,000 EXP points, 1,500,000 Zens, and 1 Jewel of Chaos as a reward from the Shadow Phantom Soldier.": "Keputusan bijak. Kalahkan 50 Totem Golem di Elveland (Area 3) dan 50 Elite Yeti di Devias (Area 3). Lakukan itu, dan kau akan menerima 60.000 poin EXP, 1.500.000 Zen, dan 1 Jewel of Chaos sebagai hadiah dari Shadow Phantom Soldier.", "A wise decision. Give me 1 million Zen and I will sign you up right away.": "Keputusan bijak. Beri aku 1 juta Zen dan kau akan langsung kudaftarkan.", "A wise decision. The test I have in mind is for you to enter Devil Square Level 2 and achieve 100 points. Do this, and I'll give you 200,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 2.": "Keputusan bijak. Ujian yang kupikirkan adalah kau masuk ke Devil Square Level 2 dan meraih 100 poin. Lakukan itu, dan aku akan memberimu 200.000 Zen sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 2.", "A wise decision. The test I have in mind is for you to enter Devil Square Level 3 and achieve 130 points. Do this successfully and I'll give you 800,000 EXP points and 500,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 3.": "Keputusan bijak. Ujian yang kupikirkan adalah kau masuk ke Devil Square Level 3 dan meraih 130 poin. Jika berhasil, aku akan memberimu 800.000 poin EXP dan 500.000 Zen sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 3.", "A wise decision. The test I have in mind is for you to enter Devil Square Level 4 and achieve 160 points. Do this successfully and I'll give you 1 Jewel of Chaos and 500,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 4.": "Keputusan bijak. Ujian yang kupikirkan adalah kau masuk ke Devil Square Level 4 dan meraih 160 poin. Jika berhasil, aku akan memberimu 1 Jewel of Chaos dan 500.000 Zen sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 4.", "A wise decision. The test I have in mind is for you to enter Devil Square Level 5 and achieve 190 points. Do this successfully and I'll give you 1 Jewel of Soul as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 5.": "Keputusan bijak. Ujian yang kupikirkan adalah kau masuk ke Devil Square Level 5 dan meraih 190 poin. Jika berhasil, aku akan memberimu 1 Jewel of Soul sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 5.", "A wise decision. (Party Possible)": "Berdasarkan penyelidikan kami, Necrons dan Death Centurions menyerap energi kegilaan saat batu perangkap beristirahat. (Party Possible)", "According to the latest intelligence, Blood Assassins have been dispatched to assassinate key figures of the Gens. Klik ikon yang dilingkari garis hijau, di sebelah kanan slot nomor lima.", "After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.": "Setelah menerima buff, kau akan melihat sebuah ikon di pojok kiri atas layar, efek cahaya biru mengelilingi karaktermu, dan damage serta pertahananmu meningkat selama satu jam.", "Agility Elves, whose priority is defense, can learn skills by equipping weapons, and Energy Elves, whose priority is wizardry, by purchasing orbs.": "Elf Agility, yang mengutamakan pertahanan, bisa mempelajari skill dengan memasang senjata, dan Elf Energy, yang mengutamakan sihir, dengan membeli orb.", "Ah, I'll have to go far back in time to explain that.;Runedil, the former queen of Elves, was saddened by the loss of all the new warriors of the MU empire, who gave up their lives to constant warring.": "Ah, aku harus kembali jauh ke masa lalu untuk menjelaskannya.;Runedil, mantan ratu para Elf, bersedih atas gugurnya semua prajurit baru kekaisaran MU yang menyerahkan nyawa dalam peperangan tanpa henti.", "Ah, you came at last. The task is to get me some equipment for the war supplies. There's no business more profitable than the war supplies delivery. It's not like the good old days, but enough for a stable income. Especially Tantalos's Armor and Burnt Murderer's Club are expensive ones. (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Ah, akhirnya kau datang. Tugasnya adalah mencarikanku perlengkapan untuk persediaan perang. Tak ada bisnis lebih menguntungkan dari pengiriman persediaan perang. Memang tidak seperti zaman keemasan dulu, tapi cukup untuk penghasilan tetap. Terutama Tantalos's Armor dan Burnt Murderer's Club adalah barang-barang mahal. (Lv. 350 - 400)", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Take the items, ingredients, and the money you need for combining to the Goblin in Noria to create a new item. Make sure to try it at least once. Let's skip to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah. Bawa item, bahan-bahan, dan uang yang kau butuhkan untuk menggabung ke Goblin di Noria untuk menciptakan item baru. Pastikan kau mencobanya setidaknya sekali. Mari kita lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. To trade, press D and select Trade or face the character and type in '/trade' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah. Untuk berdagang, tekan D dan pilih Trade atau hadapkan wajah ke karakter lalu ketik '/trade' di jendela Chat. Mari kita lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window to turn down party requests. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah. Ketik '/Request off' di jendela Chat untuk menolak permintaan party. Untuk mulai menerima permintaan party lagi, ketik '/Request on' di jendela Chat. Mari kita lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Use M to find out and travel to accessible areas with ease. Discovering areas that are right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.;On to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah. Gunakan M untuk mencari dan bepergian dengan mudah ke area yang bisa diakses. Menemukan area yang sesuai dengan levelmu, dan berburu di sana, juga bisa sangat menyenangkan.;Lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah. Saat kau ingin bicara dengan teman dan kau tahu ID-nya, atau jika kau ingin mengirim pesan pribadi, kirim whisper dengan menekan Tab dari jendela Chat. Mari kita lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah, you've answered incorrectly.; You'll be able to repair your equipment with ease by using the Repair button from the Inventory window once you reach level 50. However, this is more costly than repairing through an NPC.;Let's move on to the next question.": "Ah, jawabanmu salah.;Kau akan bisa memperbaiki perlengkapanmu dengan mudah menggunakan tombol Repair di jendela Inventory setelah kau mencapai level 50. Namun, ini lebih mahal daripada memperbaiki melalui NPC.;Mari kita lanjut ke pertanyaan berikutnya.", "Ah. So that's what happened....": "Ah. Jadi begitu ceritanya....", "All right, I'll take it. (Accept)": "Baiklah, aku terima. (Terima)", "All right. (Accept)": "Baiklah. (Terima)", "Alquamoses are the most troublesome creatures in Icarus, the path that leads to the Floating Castle. (Level 245-249)": "Alquamos adalah makhluk paling merepot
@B 26po 24000
kan di Icarus, jalan menuju Floating Castle. Stardust yang digunakan Alquamos terbukti menghancurkan pasukan pengintai kita. Maukah kau melenyapkan Alquamos ini agar pasukan pengintai kita bisa maju? (Level 245-249)", "Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.": "Baiklah! Mari kita mulai tutorialnya.", "Alright. I'll go all out on this one.": "Baiklah. Kalahkan 50 Death Knights dan kembalilah padaku untuk hadiah.", "At the Lost Tower Levels 5 and 6, you'll encounter Death Knights that were begotten from evil. Kalahkan 60 Death Knights dan kembalilah padaku untuk hadiah.", "Attack on the Supply Corps!": "Serangan terhadap Korps Pasokan!", "Barriers that have been installed in regions where monsters frequently mobilize are under attack. We must teach these monsters a lesson by striking down their superiors. Will you accept this quest? (Level 198-201)": "Penghalang yang terpasang di wilayah tempat monster sering berkumpul sedang diserang. Kita harus memberi pelajaran pada monster-monster ini dengan mengalahkan atasan mereka. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 198-201)", "Be the last one standing in Chaos Castle, deliver a weapon to Archangel in Blood Castle, and survive until the end of Devil Square. Selesaikan ketiganya dan kembalilah ke Phantom Soldier untuk menerima hadiahmu.", "Beam Knights seem to be up to something in Tarkan. Go to Tarkan level 2 and hunt down 100 Beam Knights. Come see me once that's done to receive a Devil's Invitation + 5 as a reward. They are strong foes, and you should hunt them with the help of others.": "Beam Knights sepertinya sedang merencanakan sesuatu di Tarkan. Pergilah ke Tarkan level 2 dan buru 100 Beam Knights. Temui aku setelah selesai untuk menerima Devil's Invitation + 5 sebagai hadiah. Mereka musuh yang kuat, sebaiknya kau berburu dengan bantuan orang lain.", "Before attacking the supply warehouse, we plan to defeat the monsters guarding it first. Once those monsters have been dealt with, the reconnaissance party will handle the assault on the warehouse. Will you accept this quest? (Level 56-65)": "Sebelum menyerang gudang persediaan, kami berencana mengalahkan monster yang menjaganya terlebih dahulu. Setelah monster-monster itu beres, pasukan pengintai akan menangani penyerangan ke gudang. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 56-65)", "Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)": "Lebih baik ambil kesempatan daripada menyesal. Baiklah, kembali lagi nanti jika kau berubah pikiran. Go to the Shadow Phantom Soldier and accept the quest to earn a Devil's Invitation, which you'll need to enter Devil Square.": "Devil Square adalah tempat di mana kau bisa mengembangkan kemampuan dengan cepat. Bersiaplah sepenuhnya sebelum masuk karena ini bukan tempat yang bisa diremehkan. Pergilah ke Shadow Phantom Soldier dan terima misi untuk mendapatkan Devil's Invitation, yang kau butuhkan untuk memasuki Devil Square.", "Devil Square is a place where you can hone and develop your skills fast. If you want to get stronger quickly, inquire with the Shadow Phantom Soldier about Devil Square.": "Devil Square adalah tempat di mana kau bisa mengasah dan mengembangkan skill dengan cepat. Jika kau ingin cepat menjadi lebih kuat, tanyakan pada Shadow Phantom Soldier tentang Devil Square.", "Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.": "Devil Square adalah tempat di mana Elf Tree pernah berdiri. Elf Tree diciptakan oleh ibu semua Elf, seorang Elf bawah tanah bernama Aria. Pohon ini mampu melahirkan Elf secara teratur. Kemudian Secrarium mengelabui Lugard dan muncul di Noria, di lokasi Elf Tree.", "Devil Square provides an opportunity to train yourself and build your experience. I have a little test that will tell me of your skills and experience. Would you like to take this test? (All characters: Master Level)": "Devil Square memberi kesempatan untuk berlatih dan menambah pengalamanmu. Aku punya sebuah ujian kecil yang akan menunjukkan padaku kemampuan dan pengalamanmu. Maukah kau mengikuti ujian ini? (Semua karakter: Master Level)", "Devil Square provides an opportunity to train yourself and build your experience. (Karakter dasar: Level 15-130, Karakter lanjutan: Level 10-110)", "Devil Square...": "Devil Square...", "Devils located on Levels 4 through 6 of the Lost Tower should suffice. Go to the Lost Tower and defeat 100 Devils. Come see me after that, and I will give you a choice between 15 SD Potions and 15 Complex Potions as your reward. When you claim your rewards, make sure you have at least 15 empty slots in your Inventory. Remember that.": "Devils yang berada di Lost Tower Level 4 sampai 6 seharusnya sudah cukup. Pergilah ke Lost Tower dan kalahkan 100 Devils. Temui aku setelah itu, dan aku akan memberimu pilihan antara 15 SD Potion dan 15 Complex Potion sebagai hadiah. Saat kau mengambil hadiah, pastikan kau punya setidaknya 15 slot kosong di Inventory-mu. Ingat itu.", "Did you launch the Character Stats window?;That window contains the character's name and level, the name of the current server, and character statuses.": "Apakah kau sudah membuka jendela Character Stats?;Jendela itu berisi nama dan level karakter, nama server saat ini, serta status karakter.", "Did you say the space bar?": "Apa kau bilang tombol spasi?", "Dispose of the Plunderers' Leader!": "Singkirkan Pemimpin para Perampok!", "Dispose of the Town Plunderers!": "Singkirkan para Perampok Kota!", "Doesn't sound too difficult....": "Kedengarannya tidak terlalu sulit....", "Dreadfears in Kanturu Relics are causing great harm to travelers there. Go to Kanturu Relics and hunt down 100 Dreadfears. Come see me when that's done to receive an Invisibility Cloak + 8 as a reward. At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.": "Dreadfears di Kanturu Relics membahayakan para pengembara di sana. Pergilah ke Kanturu Relics dan buru 100 Dreadfears. Temui aku setelah selesai untuk menerima Invisibility Cloak + 8 sebagai hadiah. Di levelmu sekarang, terlalu berbahaya bagimu untuk memburu monster sendirian. Lebih baik kau berburu dalam party.", "Due to Lev's illusion spells, however, the souls of the dead followers remained in this world to defend the temple. These souls believed Lev's return would allow them to reclaim their bodies and continued to safeguard the temple. Today, the temple is guarded by the alliance in case Lev does actually return and Illusion Sorcery uses ancient relics to lure in unsuspecting travelers to their cause.": "Namun, karena mantra ilusi Lev, arwah para pengikut yang telah mati tetap tinggal di dunia ini untuk membela kuil. Arwah-arwah ini percaya bahwa kembalinya Lev akan memungkinkan mereka merebut kembali tubuh mereka dan terus menjaga kuil. Kini, kuil itu dijaga oleh aliansi berjaga-jaga jika Lev benar-benar kembali, dan Ilusi Sihir menggunakan peninggalan kuno untuk memikat para pengembara yang lengah ke dalam perjuangan mereka.", "Dungeon Sweep!": "Sapu Bersih Dungeon!", "Dural, the first master of the guild was a legendary commander who led us to a great victory against Kundun's army. He had to seclude himself from the world since Gaion's rebellion and the order of exterminating 5 major clans. The newly formed mercenary guild severed whatever relations with Gaion, but 5 major clans still want the mercenary guild to get rid of Gaion.": "Dural, master pertama guild, adalah komandan legendaris yang memimpin kita meraih kemenangan besar melawan pasukan Kundun. Ia harus mengasingkan diri sejak pemberontakan Gaion dan perintah memusnahkan 5 klan besar. Guild tentara bayaran yang baru dibentuk memutus segala hubungan dengan Gaion, tapi 5 klan besar tetap ingin guild tentara bayaran menyingkirkan Gaion.", "EXP Points and Leveling Up": "Poin EXP dan Kenaikan Level", "Earn valuable equipment by completing simple quests?": "Mendapat perlengkapan berharga dengan menyelesaikan misi-misi sederhana?", "Eliminate 1 Hero Zombie Fighter and 1 Hero Reborn Gladiator and then go back to your Gens Steward to get the reward.": "Lenyapkan 1 Hero Zombie Fighter dan 1 Hero Reborn Gladiator lalu kembalilah ke Gens Steward-mu untuk mendapat hadiah.", "Eliminate 20 Bloody Slayer and 10 Vicious Bloody Slayer and then go back to your Gens Steward to get the reward.": "Lenyapkan 20 Bloody Slayer dan 10 Vicious Bloody Slayer lalu kembalilah ke Gens Steward-mu untuk mendapat hadiah.", "Eliminate 30 Aegis and 20 Rogue Centurions and go back to Beina to get the reward.": "Lenyapkan 30 Aegis dan 20 Rogue Centurions lalu kembalilah ke Beina untuk mendapat hadiah.", "Eliminate 30 Bloody Soldiers and 20 Death Angels in Kalima 6 and go back to Beina to get the reward.": "Lenyapkan 30 Bloody Soldiers dan 20 Death Angels di Kalima 6 lalu kembalilah ke Beina untuk mendapat hadiah.", "Eliminate 30 Necrons and 20 Death Centurions and then go back to Beina to get the reward.": "Lenyapkan 30 Necrons dan 20 Death Centurions lalu kembalilah ke Beina untuk mendapat hadiah.", "Eliminate 5 players of your enemy Gens and then go back to your Gens Steward to ge

"Elf bisa mempelajari skill tambahan dengan pergi ke Noria dan membeli orb dari Elf Lala (173,124) atau senjata dari Eo the Craftsman (195,123).", "End the Spread of Death Trees": "Akiri Penyebaran Death Trees", "Enter Devil Square Level 1, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. Come back afterwards, and I'll give you 100,000 EXP points and 200,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 1.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 1, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Kembalilah setelah itu, dan aku akan memberimu 100.000 poin EXP dan 200.000 Zen sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 1.", "Enter Devil Square Level 2, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. Come back to me afterwards, and I'll give you 400,000 EXP points and 300,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 2.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 2, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Kembalilah padaku setelah itu, dan aku akan memberimu 400.000 poin EXP dan 300.000 Zen sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 2.", "Enter Devil Square Level 3, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. Come back to me afterwards, and I'll give you 1,000,000 EXP points and 1 Jewel of Chaos as a reward. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 3.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 3, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Kembalilah padaku setelah itu, dan aku akan memberimu 1.000.000 poin EXP dan 1 Jewel of Chaos sebagai hadiah. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 3.", "Enter Devil Square Level 4, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. I'll give you 1 Jewel of Soul as a reward when you return. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 4.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 4, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Aku akan memberimu 1 Jewel of Soul sebagai hadiah saat kau kembali. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 4.", "Enter Devil Square Level 5, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. I'll give you 1 Jewel of Bless as a reward when you return. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 5.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 5, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Aku akan memberimu 1 Jewel of Bless sebagai hadiah saat kau kembali. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 5.", "Enter Devil Square Level 6, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. I'll give you 1 Jewel of Life as a reward when you return. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 6.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 6, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Aku akan memberimu 1 Jewel of Life sebagai hadiah saat kau kembali. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 6.", "Enter Devil Square Level 7, defeat the monsters that appear, and survive to the bitter end. I'll give you 2 Jewels of Bless as a reward when you return. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 7.": "Masuki Devil Square Level 7, kalahkan monster yang muncul, dan bertahanlah sampai akhir. Aku akan memberimu 2 Jewel of Bless sebagai hadiah saat kau kembali. Namun, ini hanya berlaku untuk Devil Square Level 7.", "Enter into Aida 2 and you will find Witch Queens. They always carry 'Kalt Stone' on themselves so eliminate them and take the jewel from them. Bring me 10 Kalt Stones. (Party Possible)": "Masuklah ke Aida 2 dan kau akan menemukan Witch Queens. Mereka selalu membawa 'Kalt Stone' pada diri mereka, jadi lenyapkan mereka dan ambil jewel-nya. Bawakan aku 10 Kalt Stones. (Party Possible)", "Evil energy has escaped from the Lost Tower and is now corrupting the souls of Devias residents, turning them into monsters. I'd like to ask you to purify their souls and give them eternal rest for us. Will you accept this quest? (Level 186-189)": "Energi jahat telah lepas dari Lost Tower dan kini merusak jiwa penduduk Devias, mengubah mereka menjadi monster. Aku ingin memintamu menyucikan jiwa mereka dan memberi mereka istirahat abadi untuk kita. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 186-189)", "Excellent! Bring on the test!": "Luar biasa! Bawa ujiannya!", "Excellent! I will be back in a flash.": "Luar biasa! Aku akan segera kembali.", "Excellent! It's time for the next quest. Since you are now familiar with hunting, let's get you to go after a tougher monster.": "Luar biasa! Saatnya misi berikutnya. Karena kau kini sudah familiar dengan berburu, mari kita arahkan kau memburu monster yang lebih tangguh.", "Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.": "Luar biasa! Mari kita mulai tutorialnya.", "Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?": "Luar biasa! Siapa nama monster yang ingin kau buru?", "Expanding businesses": "Memperluas usaha", "Explain potions to me once more.": "Jelaskan ramuan padaku sekali lagi.", "Fast growth...": "Pertumbuhan cepat...", "Fastest Way to Train (1)": "Cara Tercepat Berlatih (1)", "Fastest Way to Train (2)": "Cara Tercepat Berlatih (2)", "Fastest Way to Train (3)": "Cara Tercepat Berlatih (3)", "Fastest Way to Train (4)": "Cara Tercepat Berlatih (4)", "Fastest Way to Train (5)": "Cara Tercepat Berlatih (5)", "Final Test to become a Hero": "Ujian Akhir untuk Menjadi Pahlawan", "Finally, a quest! You want me to buy 5 apples from a merchant?": "Akhirnya, sebuah misi! Kau mau aku membeli 5 apel dari pedagang?", "Find 2 pages of 'Lost Map Lv. 4' and return to 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.": "Cari 2 lembar 'Lost Map Lv. 4' dan kembalilah ke 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.", "Find 2 pages of 'Lost Map Lv. 5' and return to 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.": "Cari 2 lembar 'Lost Map Lv. 5' dan kembalilah ke 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.", "Find 3 pages of 'Lost Map Lv. 3' and return to 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.": "Cari 3 lembar 'Lost Map Lv. 3' dan kembalilah ke 'Shadow Phantom Soldier'.", "Find General Goods Merchant Zyro": "Cari General Goods Merchant Zyro", "Find General Goods Merchant Zyro and check the details of his request to the mercenary guild.": "Cari General Goods Merchant Zyro dan periksa rincian permintaannya kepada guild tentara bayaran.", "Find General Goods Merchant Zyro who goes round Noria, Elveland, Lorencia and Devias and sell things.": "Cari General Goods Merchant Zyro yang berkeliling Noria, Elveland, Lorencia, dan Devias untuk berjualan.", "Find Priestess Beina of the Underwater Temple in Kalima 6 and check the request information.": "Cari Priestess Beina dari Underwater Temple di Kalima 6 dan periksa informasi permintaan.", "Find merchant Zyro, who goes round Noria, Elveland, Lorencia and Devias and sell things.": "Cari merchant Zyro, yang berkeliling Noria, Elveland, Lorencia, dan Devias untuk berjualan.", "Find the guild office manager Tercia and pay 500,000 Zen as a deposit to receive Lv. 1 Letter of Request which contains the quest of the day.": "Cari guild office manager Tercia dan bayar 500.000 Zen sebagai deposit untuk menerima Lv. 1 Letter of Request yang berisi misi hari ini.", "Find your Gens Steward.": "Cari Gens Steward-mu.", "First task is to collect the Stardust, which is the base material of the popular cosmetic product, Della. The ladies in a queue threaten me so I had to ask the mercenary guild. You can extract a small amount of Stardust from Queen Rainiers in the Icarus. Please bring me 20 units of Stardust. (Party Possible)": "Tugas pertama adalah mengumpulkan Stardust, bahan dasar produk kosmetik populer, Della. Para wanita yang mengantre mengancamku jadi aku harus meminta bantuan guild tentara bayaran. Kau bisa mengambil sedikit Stardust dari Queen Rainiers di Icarus. Bawakan aku 20 Stardust. (Party Possible)", "First you need to eliminate Kundun's combatants who attack the temple entrance and then get rid of the enemies who cast spell on the sealed stone. I'll give you the 2nd goal when you finish 1st goal and come back to me. Here's the 1st goal; go to Kalima 6 and eliminate 30 Aegis and 20 Rogue Centurions, Kundun's combatants. (Party Possible)": "Pertama kau harus melenyapkan prajurit Kundun yang menyerang pintu masuk kuil lalu singkirkan musuh-musuh yang melemparkan mantra pada batu perangkap. Aku akan memberimu tujuan ke-2 saat kau menyelesaikan tujuan ke-1 dan kembali padaku. Ini tujuan ke-1; pergilah ke Kalima 6 dan lenyapkan 30 Aegis dan 20 Rogue Centurions, prajurit Kundun. (Party Possible)", "Free mercenary doesn't really belong to the mercenary guild; anybody can receive a request and get the reward only if he or she has certain sum of money for registration. We take the deposit for each request, but it's fully refundable as you finish the request. Don't you worry. We request you what you can handle.": "Tentara bayaran bebas sebenarnya tidak tergabung dalam guild tentara bayaran; siapa pun bisa menerima permintaan dan mendapatkan hadiah asalkan dia punya sejumlah uang untuk pendaftaran. Kami mengambil deposit untuk setiap permintaan, tapi itu sepenuhnya dikembalikan saat kau menyelesaikannya. Jangan khawatir. Kami hanya memberimu permintaan yang sanggup kau tangani.", "From the Chat window, use the Ctrl button.": "Dari jendela Chat, gunakan tombol Ctrl.", "From the Chat window, use the Shift button.": "Dari jendela Chat, gunakan tombol Shift.", "From the Chat window, use the Tab button.": "Dari jendela Chat, gunakan tombol Tab.", "Gain EXP points to level up.;You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.;The bar is divided into ten segments, and filling them up will elevate you to the next level.": "Kumpulkan poin EXP untuk naik level.;Kau bisa tahu berapa banyak poin lagi yang kau butuhkan untuk mencapai level berikutnya dengan memeriksa jendela Character Stats atau bar EXP di bagian bawah layarmu.;Bar itu terbagi menjadi sepuluh segmen, dan mengisinya akan membawamu ke level berikutnya.", "Gens Duprian is a guild of the greatest heroes in Arca and at its heart is the Duprian clan, the mightiest noble bloodline in MU. We are led by Duprian Winston, a knight who knows no equal in the whole of the MU empire.": "Gens Duprian adalah guild para pahlawan terhebat di Arca dan di pusatnya berdiri klan Duprian, garis bangsawan terkuat di MU. Kami dipimpin Duprian Winston, seorang ksatria yang tak tertandingi di seluruh kekaisaran MU.", "Gens Ranking Reward": "Hadiah Peringkat Gens", "Gens Vanert is a noble family led by Vanert Reicht, the greatest socialite in the whole of the MU empire. The master strives around the clock to put a stop to Duprian Winston and his dream of absolute rule over the empire.": "Gens Vanert adalah keluarga bangsawan yang dipimpin Vanert Reicht, sosialita terhebat di seluruh kekaisaran MU. Sang tuan bekerja sepanjang waktu untuk menghentikan Duprian Winston dan mimpi kekuasaan mutlaknya atas kekaisaran.", "Gens dispute…? Gens Vanert’s rebellion is more like it. The gens dispute started because of the greed of Vanert Reicht, the commanding knight of Gens Vanert. Exactly five years ago, a band of heroes who were searching in La Cleon for a stone with the power to seal away Kundun were slaughtered. At the time, we believed it was the work of Selupan, a giant spider and the ruler of La Cleon, but soon learned that it was actually Gens Vanert. It is the duty of our proud Gens Duprian champions to retaliate and fight.": "Perselisihan gens…? Pemberontakan Gens Vanert lebih tepatnya. Perselisihan gens bermula karena keserakahan Vanert Reicht, ksatria komandan Gens Vanert. Tepat lima tahun lalu, sekelompok pahlawan yang sedang mencari di La Cleon sebuah batu berkuasa menyegel Kundun dibantai. Saat itu, kami percaya itu ulah Selupan, seekor laba-laba raksasa dan penguasa La Cleon, tapi segera sadar bahwa itu sebenarnya ulah Gens Vanert. Adalah tugas para juara Gens Duprian yang bangga untuk membalas dan bertarung.", "Gens ranking rewards are given out in the first week of each month.": "Hadiah peringkat gens dibagikan pada minggu pertama setiap bulan.", "Get rid of Kundun and 10 Schrikers, the guard soldiers in the innermost depth of Kalima 6 and come back to me to get reward. (Party Possible)": "Singkirkan Kundun dan 10 Schrikers, para prajurit penjaga di terdalam Kalima 6, dan kembalilah padaku untuk mendapat hadiah. (Party Possible)", "Give me a letter of request.": "Beri aku sebuah letter of request.", "Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)": "Beri aku waktu untuk bersiap. (Tolak)", "Glory to the Gens": "Kemuliaan bagi Gens", "Go ahead and learn the Fire Ball skill.": "Silakan lanjutkan dan pelajari skill Fire Ball.", "Go back.": "Kembali.", "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.": "Pergilah melewati tembok Elveland dan buru 3 Strange Rabbits.", "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": "Pergilah melewati tembok Elveland dan buru 3 Strange Rabbits.;Jika kau dalam masalah, tekan tombol Q untuk memulihkan HP-mu. Kalahkan 60 Iron Wheels dan kembalilah padaku untuk hadiah.", "Good decision. The first mission for the second trial involves defeating 10 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, a Jewel of Chaos, or a Jewel of Harmony.": "Keputusan tepat. Misi pertama ujian kedua mencakup mengalahkan 10 Guardsmen di Chaos Castle, mengantarkan senjata Archangel di Blood Castle, dan bertahan sampai akhir Devil Square. Selesaikan misinya dan kau akan dihadiahi salah satu dari Jewel of Bless, Jewel of Soul, Jewel of Chaos, atau Jewel of Harmony.", "Good decision. The first mission of the fifth trial involves surviving in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Life, a Jewel of Harmony, or two Jewels of Soul.": "Keputusan tepat. Misi pertama ujian kelima mencakup bertahan hidup di Chaos Castle, mengantarkan senjata Archangel di Blood Castle, dan bertahan sampai akhir Devil Square. Selesaikan misinya dan kau akan dihadiahi salah satu dari Jewel of Bless, Jewel of Life, Jewel of Harmony, atau dua Jewel of Soul.", "Good decision. The first mission of the fourth trial involves defeating 30 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Life, a Jewel of Harmony, or two Jewels of Soul.": "Keputusan tepat. Misi pertama ujian keempat mencakup mengalahkan 30 Guardsmen di Chaos Castle, mengantarkan senjata Archangel di Blood Castle, dan bertahan sampai akhir Devil Square. Selesaikan misinya dan kau akan dihadiahi salah satu dari Jewel of Bless, Jewel of Life, Jewel of Harmony, atau dua Jewel of Soul.", "Good decision. The first mission of the last trial involves surviving in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete this mission successfully and you may be reborn as hero. Your fame will echo across the whole continent of MU. You'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, two Jewels of Life, or two Jewels of Soul upon completion.": "Keputusan tepat. Misi pertama ujian terakhir mencakup bertahan hidup di Chaos Castle, mengantarkan senjata Archangel di Blood Castle, dan bertahan sampai akhir Devil Square. Selesaikan misi ini dengan sukses dan kau boleh dilahirkan kembali sebagai pahlawan. Ketenaranmu akan bergema di seluruh benua MU. Kau akan dihadiahi salah satu dari Jewel of Bless, dua Jewel of Life, atau dua Jewel of Soul setelah selesai.", "Good decision. This mission requires you to raise your worth by claiming victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 800,000 Exp.": "Keputusan tepat. Misi ini menuntutmu meningkatkan nilaimu dengan meraih kemenangan di Illusion Temple. Selesaikan misinya dan kau akan dihadiahi 800.000 Exp.", "Good job. The energy of insanity is safely contained since Necrons and Death Centurions have been eliminated. But the portion they already absorbed has been transferred to Kundun so we need to directly attack him. Can you help us? (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Bagus. Energi kegilaan kini terkendali dengan aman karena Necrons dan Death Centurions telah dilenyapkan. Tapi porsi yang telah mereka serap sudah dialihkan ke Kundun jadi kita harus menyerangnya langsung. Bisakah kau membantu kami? (Lv. 350 - 400)", "Good job. You made it easier for us to protect the temple entrance. The 2nd goal is to punish the enemies attacking the sealed stone. Etramu saved the empire by changing his body into a sealed stone, but his soul is getting engulfed with madness. Do you want to proceed? (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Bagus. Kau mempermudah kami menjaga pintu masuk kuil. Tujuan ke-2 adalah menghukum musuh-musuh yang menyerang batu perangkap. Etramu menyelamatkan kekaisaran dengan mengubah tubuhnya menjadi batu perangkap, tapi jiwanya kini dilanda kegilaan. Apa kau mau lanjut? (Lv. 350 - 400)", "Grand Wizard Etramu vowed to destroy Illusion Sorcery and formed an army to subjugate its followers. Under Etramu's command, the alliance engaged the followers of Illusion Sorcery with formidable force. Despite having been driven all the way back to Illusion Temple, the followers continued to resist. As battle raged on, Lev disappeared and left the followers of Illusion Sorcery in confusion. Ultimately, they all met their death at the hands of the alliance on the temple grounds.": "Grand Wizard Etramu bersumpah menghancurkan Illusion Sorcery dan membentuk pasukan untuk menaklukkan para pengikutnya. Di bawah komando Etramu, aliansi melawan para pengikut Illusion Sorcery dengan kekuatan besar. Meski telah didesak mundur sampai ke Illusion Temple, para pengikut itu tetap melawan. Saat pertempuran berkecamuk, Lev menghilang dan meninggalkan para pengikut Illusion Sorcery dalam kebingungan. Pada akhirnya, mereka semua tewas di tangan aliansi di area kuil.", "Great! I finally get the chance to show off what I can do.": "Hebat! Akhirnya aku dapat kesempatan untuk memamerkan kemampuanku.", "Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!": "Hebat! Tutorial ini akan kuselesaikan sekejap!", "Have you been to Chaos Castle? If not, it'll be an excellent opportunity to prove your strength. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 50-119, Advanced character: Level 30-99)": "Pernahkah kau ke Chaos Castle? Jika belum, ini kesempatan bagus untuk membuktikan kekuatanmu. Mengapa kau tidak mendengarkan dulu apa yang kukatakan lalu memutuskan? (Karakter dasar: Level 50-119, Karakter lanjutan: Level 30-99)", "Have you cleared today's request? Show me Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate then.": "Sudahkah kau menyelesaikan permintaan hari ini? Tunjukkan Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate padaku kalau begitu.", "Have you ever heard of Blood Castle's barrier? Would you like to hear Archangel's request to help defend Blood Castle's barrier and join in the fight for the castle? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)": "Pernahkah kau mendengar tentang penghalang Blood Castle? Mau mendengar permintaan Archangel untuk membantu mempertahankan penghalang Blood Castle dan ikut bertarung demi kastil? (Karakter dasar: Level 15-80, Karakter lanjutan: Level 10-60)", "Have you ever heard of Blood Castle's barrier? Would you like to hear Archangel's request to help defend Blood Castle's barrier and join the fight for the castle? (Basic character: Level 81-130, Advanced character: Level 61-110)": "Pernahkah kau mendengar tentang penghalang Blood Castle? Mau mendengar permintaan Archangel untuk membantu mempertahankan penghalang Blood Castle dan ikut bertarung demi kastil? (Karakter dasar: Level 81-130, Karakter lanjutan: Level 61-110)", "Have you ever heard of Illusion Temple and the ancient relics hidden there? It's a place where travelers can find both wealth and fame. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (All characters: Level 220-270)": "Pernahkah kau mendengar tentang Illusion Temple dan peninggalan kuno yang tersembunyi di sana? Itu tempat para pengembara bisa menemukan kekayaan sekaligus ketenaran. Mengapa kau tidak mendengarkan dulu apa yang kukatakan lalu memutuskan? (Semua karakter: Level 220-270)", "Have you ever heard of Illusion Temple and the ancient relics hidden there? It's a place where travelers can find both wealth and fame. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (All characters: Level 271-320)": "Pernahkah kau mendengar tentang Illusion Temple dan peninggalan kuno yang tersembunyi di sana? Itu tempat para pengembara bisa menemukan kekayaan sekaligus ketenaran. Mengapa kau tidak mendengarkan dulu apa yang kukatakan lalu memutuskan? (Semua karakter: Level 271-320)", "Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters.  The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.": "Setelah mengincar kekuatan kelahiran pohon itu, Secrarium merusak Elf Tree dan mengubahnya menjadi Immoral Tree yang melahirkan monster. Kawanan monster tumbuh hingga luar biasa besarnya, dan kerajaan-kerajaan di benua MU menggabungkan kekuatan mereka untuk menjebak pohon jahat itu di ruang kehampaan.", "Having trustworthy comrades at your side makes all the difference when it comes to Blood Castle quests. However, it will still be hard for you to obtain an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level. I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 331-400, Advanced character: Level 311-400)": "Punya rekan yang bisa dipercaya di sisimu membuat perbedaan besar dalam misi Blood Castle. Namun, tetap akan sulit bagimu untuk mendapatkan Invisibility Cloak yang sesuai levelmu. Aku punya misi yang akan memberimu item yang kau butuhkan untuk memasuki Blood Castle. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Karakter dasar: Level 331-400, Karakter lanjutan: Level 311-400)", "Hear what the Shadow Phantom Soldier has to say and take the Blood Castle challenge. Successfully complete the Blood Castle quest to receive a valuable reward.": "Dengarkan apa yang dikatakan Shadow Phantom Soldier dan ambil tantangan Blood Castle. Selesaikan misi Blood Castle dengan sukses untuk menerima hadiah berharga.", "Hear what the Shadow Phantom Soldier has to say and take the Chaos Castle challenge. If you survive Chaos Castle, you can claim a hefty reward.": "Dengarkan apa yang dikatakan Shadow Phantom Soldier dan ambil tantangan Chaos Castle. Jika kau bertahan di Chaos Castle, kau bisa mengklaim hadiah besar.", "Hear what the Shadow Phantom Soldier has to say and take the Devil Square challenge. Training at Devil Square will earn you a valuable reward.": "Dengarkan apa yang dikatakan Shadow Phantom Soldier dan ambil tantangan Devil Square. Berlatih di Devil Square akan memberimu hadiah berharga.", "Hear what the Shadow Phantom Soldier has to say and take the Illusion Temple challenge. Win at Illusion Temple to claim a valuable reward.": "Dengarkan apa yang dikatakan Shadow Phantom Soldier dan ambil tantangan Illusion Temple. Menang di Illusion Temple untuk mengklaim hadiah berharga.", "Help the reconnaissance party....": "Bantulah pasukan pengintai....", "Here is the Letter of Request for you. Right click on the letter to check the information. Please note that you cannot receive refund of 500,000 Zen deposit if you give up the quest. You also need to bring the 'Request Completion Certificate' to get the refund. Once again, you need to press (T) and click 'Start Quest' button at the bottom to check the information again once you close the information window. Good bye, then.": "Ini Letter of Request untukmu. Klik kanan pada surat itu untuk memeriksa informasinya. Perhatikan bahwa kau tidak bisa menerima pengembalian deposit 500.000 Zen jika kau menyerah pada misi. Kau juga perlu membawa 'Request Completion Certificate' untuk mendapat pengembalian dana. Sekali lagi, kau perlu menekan (T) dan klik tombol 'Start Quest' di bagian bawah untuk memeriksa informasi lagi setelah kau menutup jendela informasi. Sampai jumpa.", "Here it is.": "Ini dia.", "Here you go.": "Ini untukmu.", "Here's your first question.;How do you trade with a character that's in front of you?": "Ini pertanyaan pertamamu.;Bagaimana cara berdagang dengan karakter yang ada di depanmu?", "Hero
@B 26pt 24000
ic Courage": "Keberanian Heroik", "Heroic Fighting Spirit": "Semangat Juang Heroik", "Heroic Mentality": "Mental Heroik", "Heroic Qualities": "Kualitas Heroik", "Heroic Tenacity": "Ketangguhan Heroik", "Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. The sealed stone got stronger thanks to your effort, but Kundun's army is also getting stronger now. We investigated the sealed stone and found that Kundun's army absorbs its energy while Etramu's soul is taking a rest. Please help us and confine the energy of insanity within the sealed stone. (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Hai, aku Priestess Beina, penjaga Underwater Temple ini. Batu perangkap makin kuat berkat usahamu, tapi pasukan Kundun juga kini makin kuat. Kami menyelidiki batu perangkap dan menemukan bahwa pasukan Kundun menyerap energinya saat jiwa Etramu beristirahat. Tolong bantu kami dan kurung energi kegilaan di dalam batu perangkap. (Lv. 350 - 400)", "Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. This temple is Kundun's first target since Etramu keeps his body in the sealed stone. We're always short of fighters so I request help to the mercenary guild. Would you check the request? (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Hai, aku Priestess Beina, penjaga Underwater Temple ini. Kuil ini adalah target pertama Kundun karena Etramu menyimpan tubuhnya di batu perangkap. Kami selalu kekurangan pejuang jadi aku meminta bantuan pada guild tentara bayaran. Maukah kau memeriksa permintaannya? (Lv. 350 - 400)", "Hidden history of the rebellion": "Sejarah tersembunyi pemberontakan", "High ranking monsters deep inside the Lost Tower have launched a surprise attack on our reconnaissance party. Under the captain's orders to retaliate, we are now forming a punishment force. Will you accept this quest? (Level 206-209)": "Monster-monster berpangkat tinggi di terdalam Lost Tower melancarkan serangan mendadak ke pasukan pengintai kita. Di bawah perintah kapten untuk membalas, kami kini membentuk pasukan penghukum. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 206-209)", "Hmm, Letter of Request……": "Hmm, Letter of Request……", "Hmm, free mercenary……": "Hmm, tentara bayaran bebas……", "Hmm... that doesn't sound all that bad.": "Hmm... kedengarannya tidak terlalu buruk.", "Hmm... you are a wise warrior. Go now and achieve great things in the name Gens Vanert, knowing that I will always be here to assist you.": "Hmm... kau prajurit yang bijak. Pergilah sekarang dan raih hal-hal besar atas nama Gens Vanert, sadarlah bahwa aku akan selalu ada di sini untuk membantumu.", "Hmm...First, press M and then...": "Hmm...Pertama, tekan M lalu...", "Hmm...a test...": "Hmm...sebuah ujian...", "Hold on, I will find a quest suitable for you. Wait a moment please. (Level 260-289)": "Tunggu, aku akan mencari misi yang cocok untukmu. Sebentar ya. (Level 260-289)", "Hold on, I will find a quest suitable for you. Wait a moment please. (Level 290-319)": "Tunggu, aku akan mencari misi yang cocok untukmu. Sebentar ya. (Level 290-319)", "Hold on, I will find a quest suitable for you. Wait a moment please. (Level 320-349)": "Tunggu, aku akan mencari misi yang cocok untukmu. Sebentar ya. (Level 320-349)", "How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!": "Bagaimana aku bisa menolaknya...?;Baiklah, mari kita coba!", "How do I check coordinates?": "Bagaimana cara memeriksa koordinat?", "How do I get it?": "Bagaimana cara mendapatkannya?", "How do you do? I am Gregory, the Gens Duprian Steward. What is your business with our gens?": "Apa kabar? Aku Gregory, Gens Duprian Steward. Ada urusan apa kau dengan gens kami?", "How have you been? On behalf of the master of our clan, I thank you for answering the call of the clan. I personally hate to let the wandering mercenaries do this job, so I requested to send someone of the clan. I hope this didn't offend you. (Lv. 350 - 400)": "Apa kabar? Atas nama tuan klan kami, aku berterima kasih kau telah menanggapi panggilan klan. Aku pribadi tak suka membiarkan tentara bayaran pengembara melakukan tugas ini, jadi aku meminta dikirim seseorang dari klan. Aku harap ini tidak menyinggung perasaanmu. (Lv. 350 - 400)", "How much is the registration fee and the deposit?": "Berapa biaya pendaftaran dan depositnya?", "How will you help, exactly?": "Bagaimana tepatnya kau akan membantu?", "However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?": "Namun, perjalanan seperti ini pasti penuh bahaya.;Jika kau mau, kami bisa memberimu tutorial sederhana. Bagaimana?", "Hunt down 10 Spiders from around town, and I'll give you a reward.": "Buru 10 Spiders di sekitar kota, dan aku akan memberimu hadiah.", "Hunting down measly Spiders is beneath me. (Refuse)": "Memburu Spiders remeh seperti itu di bawah derajatku. (Tolak)", "Hunting down monsters....": "Memburu monster....", "Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.": "Memburu monster akan memberimu poin EXP, item drop, dan Zen.", "I accept the mission. (Accept)": "Aku menerima misinya. (Terima)", "I accept your quest. (Accept)": "Aku menerima misimu. (Terima)", "I already knew that.": "Aku sudah tahu itu.", "I already knew that. What's the next quest?": "Aku sudah tahu itu. Apa misi berikutnya?", "I am not ready yet. (Refuse)": "Aku belum siap. (Tolak)", "I can almost see the end! (Accept)": "Aku hampir bisa melihat akhirnya! (Terima)", "I can't pass up on this. (Accept)": "Aku tak bisa melewatkan ini. (Terima)", "I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)": "Aku tak bermaksud mengganggumu. Tapi seiring klan makin kuat, kau pun ikut makin kuat. Silakan kembali jika kau berubah pikiran. (Misi telah dibatalkan.)", "I don't feel like doing it. (Refuse)": "Aku lagi tidak ingin melakukannya. (Tolak)", "I don't have the time right now. (Refuse)": "Aku tidak ada waktu sekarang. (Tolak)", "I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.": "Aku tidak ada waktu sekarang. (Refuse)": "Aku tidak ada waktu sekarang. Aku akan kembali lagi nanti. (Tolak)", "I don't know how this story can help me. (Refuse)": "Aku tak tahu bagaimana cerita ini bisa membantuku. (Tolak)", "I don't need to be judged like this! (Refuse)": "Aku tak perlu dihakimi seperti ini! (Tolak)", "I don't think I have time for that right now. (Refuse)": "Sepertinya aku tidak punya waktu untuk itu sekarang. (Tolak)", "I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.": "Aku belum ingin memutuskan sekarang. Jelaskan saja padaku.", "I give up. Going any further is beyond me. (Refuse)": "Aku menyerah. Melangkah lebih jauh lagi di luar kemampuanku. (Tolak)", "I got it!": "Aku mengerti!", "I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?": "Sepertinya Lugard dikelabui Secrarium. Bagaimana cara aku ikut?", "I have a monster hunt quest that will take you deeper into the Dungeon than before. Will you accept this quest? (Level 101-110)": "Aku punya misi berburu monster yang akan membawamu lebih dalam ke Dungeon daripada sebelumnya. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 101-110)", "I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 131-180, Advanced character: Level 111-160)": "Aku punya misi yang akan memberimu item yang kau butuhkan untuk memasuki Blood Castle. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Karakter dasar: Level 131-180, Karakter lanjutan: Level 111-160)", "I have a quest that will take you deep inside the Dungeon. It'll be harder than last time, but there's a better reward. Will you accept this quest? (Level 121-130)": "Aku punya misi yang akan membawamu jauh ke dalam Dungeon. Ini akan lebih sulit dari terakhir kali, tapi ada hadiah yang lebih baik. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 121-130)", "I have a quest that will take you deep inside the Dungeon. There have been reports of monsters attempting to make their way above ground under the command of Gorgons. I want you to defeat these monsters. (Level 111-120)": "Aku punya misi yang akan membawamu jauh ke dalam Dungeon. Ada laporan monster yang berusaha naik ke permukaan di bawah komando Gorgons. Aku ingin kau mengalahkan monster-monster ini. (Level 111-120)", "I have a simple quest that will earn you a Scroll of Blood, which will grant you access to Illusion Temple. Will you accept? (All characters: Level 321-350)": "Aku punya misi sederhana yang akan memberimu Scroll of Blood, yang memberimu akses ke Illusion Temple. Maukah kau menerima? (Semua karakter: Level 321-350)", "I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 181-230, Advanced character: Level 161-210)": "Aku punya misi sederhana yang akan memberimu undangan yang memberi akses ke Devil Square. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Karakter dasar: Level 181-230, Karakter lanjutan: Level 161-210)", "I have no time right now. (Refuse)": "Aku tidak ada waktu sekarang. (Tolak)", "I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!": "Aku sudah banyak pengalaman.;Lain orang lain pula caranya!", "I hope you realize that a hero without a fighting spirit is merely a coward.": "Aku harap kau sadar bahwa pahlawan tanpa semangat juang hanyalah seorang pengecut.", "I know it well. I hear you need a special item to go there....": "Aku tahu betul. Kudengar kau butuh item khusus untuk pergi ke sana....", "I know it well. I hear you need an item to participate in the event....": "Aku tahu betul. Kudengar kau butuh sebuah item untuk ikut event....", "I learned a skill!": "Aku mempelajari sebuah skill!", "I need you to accept a small quest first as a test. Are you up to it? There is of course a reasonable reward for finishing.": "Aku mau kau menerima misi kecil dulu sebagai ujian. Kau sanggup? Tentu ada hadiah yang layak saat selesai.", "I neither have the skills nor the warriors I need to take on this quest. Give me more time.": "Aku belum punya kemampuan maupun prajurit yang kubutuhkan untuk misi ini. Beri aku waktu lagi.", "I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.": "Aku menyesal kami tak bisa membantumu.;Ini, terimalah setidaknya hadiah ini. Aku harap, saat kita bertemu lagi, seorang prajurit hebat berdiri di hadapanku.;Nikmatilah waktu petualanganmu di luar sana.", "I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.": "Aku menghormati keputusanmu untuk pergi dalam perjalanan ini.;Izinkan aku mengajarkan beberapa hal sederhana tapi penting yang perlu kau tahu sebelum petualanganmu di MU dimulai.", "I see you've now mastered hunting. Did you find it difficult? Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.;You can pick up items dropped by defeated monsters using the mouse or automatically by pressing the space bar.": "Aku lihat kau telah berhasil menyelesaikan perburuan pertamamu! Apa kau merasa sulit? Memburu monster akan memberimu poin EXP, item drop, dan Zen.;Kau bisa mengambil item yang dijatuhkan monster yang dikalahkan dengan mouse atau secara otomatis dengan menekan tombol spasi.", "I see.": "Begitu.", "I see. How do I enter?": "Begitu. Bagaimana cara masuknya?", "I simply can't go on anymore. (Refuse)": "Aku benar-benar tak bisa melanjutkan lagi. (Tolak)", "I think I have enough courage already. (Refuse)": "Sepertinya aku sudah cukup punya keberanian. (Tolak)", "I think a quest involving the Dungeon, which is a headache for Lorencia, should be suitable for you. (Level 91-100)": "Sepertinya misi yang melibatkan Dungeon, yang menjadi penyakit kepala bagi Lorencia, cocok untukmu. Aku mau kau habisi monster-monster di Dungeon, satu per satu. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 91-100)", "I trust you are quite used to Devil Square by now. However, obtaining an invitation to Devil Square remains a difficult task. Luckily, I have a quest that will earn you an invitation. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 231-280, Advanced character: Level 211-260)": "Aku yakin kau kini sudah cukup terbiasa dengan Devil Square. Namun, mendapatkan undangan ke Devil Square tetaplah tugas yang sulit. Untungnya, aku punya misi yang akan memberimu undangan. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Karakter dasar: Level 231-280, Karakter lanjutan: Level 211-260)", "I trust you are somewhat familiar with Blood Castle by now. You should now focus on building the bond between you and your comrades to the point where you can rely on each another unconditionally.": "Aku yakin kau kini sudah agak familiar dengan Blood Castle. Sekarang kau harus fokus memperkuat ikatan antara kau dan rekan-rekanmu sampai pada titik di mana kalian bisa saling bergantung tanpa syarat.", "I trust you are somewhat familiar with Chaos Castle by now. However, it should still be difficult for you to acquire the necessary item. I have a quest for you. One through which you can earn the items you'll need in Chaos Castle.... Will you accept? (Basic character: Level 240-299, Advanced character: Level 220-279)": "Aku yakin kau kini sudah agak familiar dengan Chaos Castle. Namun, tetap akan sulit bagimu untuk mendapatkan item yang diperlukan. Aku punya misi untukmu. Misi yang memberimu item-item yang kau butuhkan di Chaos Castle.... Maukah kau menerima? (Karakter dasar: Level 240-299, Karakter lanjutan: Level 220-279)", "I trust you are somewhat familiar with Chaos Castle by now. The event will now be even more challenging because you will face more powerful users and corrupt guardsmen.": "Aku yakin kau kini sudah agak familiar dengan Chaos Castle. Event ini kini akan lebih menantang karena kau akan menghadapi para pengguna yang lebih kuat dan guardsmen yang korup.", "I trust you are somewhat familiar with Devil Square by now. You'll now be moved to a place where even more powerful monsters spawn. There's no need to worry, however. Kau kini akan dipindahkan ke tempat di mana monster yang lebih kuat lagi muncul. Tapi tak perlu khawatir. Kau bisa berharap pertumbuhan pesat selama kau dan rekan-rekanmu melakukan serangan terkoordinasi.", "I trust you are somewhat familiar with Illusion Temple by now. You'll now be moved to a place where even more powerful monsters spawn. There's no need to worry, however. Kau kini akan dipindahkan ke tempat di mana monster yang lebih kuat lagi muncul. Tapi tak perlu khawatir. Kau bisa berharap pertumbuhan pesat selama kau dan rekan-rekanmu belajar bekerja sama.", "I understand well. What's the next quest?": "Aku mengerti. (Karakter dasar: Level 120-179, Karakter lanjutan: Level 100-159)", "I will give you the queen's gifts if you pass a test to see if there's anything else you need to know and if you have the basic knowledge to travel throughout the MU realm. Bagaimana?", "I will guide you through MU game play.": "Aku akan memandu permainan MU-mu.", "I will help you. Tell me what to do. (Accept)": "Aku akan membantumu. Katakan apa yang harus kulakukan. (Terima)", "I will inform you when a request of your level is delivered. Thank you.": "Aku akan memberitahumu saat permintaan yang sesuai levelmu tiba. Terima kasih.", "I will sign up. (Accept)": "Aku akan mendaftar. (Terima)", "I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.": "Aku akan mengajarimu dasar berburu dan kontrol lewat tutorial sederhana.;Tidak sesulit itu, dan aku yakin kau akan menyelesaikannya sekejap.", "I will teach you hunting and control commands through a simple tutorial.": "Aku akan mengajarimu berburu dan perintah kontrol lewat tutorial sederhana.", "I will tell you then. Pengawal kerajaan Devildom, yang dipanggil saat Kundun tunduk pada Secrarium, menjadi ancaman besar bagi dunia atas. Untuk melindungi markas mereka, Dua Belas Orang Suci membentuk penghalang di sekeliling Blood Castle.", "I'd rather you give me the gifts without the test.": "Aku lebih suka kau memberiku hadiahnya tanpa ujian.", "I'll explain this in more detail. (Accept)": "Aku akan tetap fokus sampai akhir! (Terima)", "I'll test you to see if you have the basic knowledge required for travel throughout the MU empire and give you the queen's gifts if you pass.": "Aku akan mengujimu untuk melihat apakah kau punya pengetahuan dasar yang diperlukan untuk menjelajahi seluruh kekaisaran MU dan memberimu hadiah sang ratu jika kau lulus.", "I'm always up for hunting down monsters....": "Aku selalu siap memburu monster....", "I'm busy now. (Refuse)": "Aku belum siap. Mohon tunggu. (Tolak)", "I'm sorry to hear that. There are many ways to become stronger, but they'll all take time. Remember that well.": "Aku menyesal mendengarnya. Ada banyak cara untuk menjadi lebih kuat, tapi semuanya butuh waktu. Ingat itu baik-baik.", "I'm sorry to hear that. You can't repeat the first mission if you abandon the second mission. You must complete the second mission before you can repeat the first mission. Please return if you change your mind.": "Aku menyesal mendengarnya. Kau tak bisa mengulang misi pertama jika kau meninggalkan misi kedua. Kau harus menyelesaikan misi kedua sebelum bisa mengulang misi pertama. Silakan kembali jika kau berubah pikiran.", "I'm sorry. I don't have the time right now. (Refuse)": "Maaf. Aku tidak ada waktu sekarang. (Tolak)", "I'm sorry. I don't have the time. (Refuse)": "Maaf. Aku tidak ada waktu. (Tolak)", "I'm sure you are well aware of Kundun. The weakest and most disorganized monsters of Kundun's army are frequently attacking and plundering civilians just outside of town. I wanted to ask you to eliminate these plundering monsters.... Will you accept this quest? (Level 15-25)": "Aku yakin kau sudah kenal Kundun dengan baik. Monster-monster terlemah dan paling kacau dalam pasukan Kundun sering menyerang dan merampok warga sipil di luar kota. Aku ingin memintamu melenyapkan monster-monster perampok ini.... Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Level 15-25)", "I'm sure you have a long trail of defeated monsters behind you. However, travelers widely vary in terms of their skills. If you're unsure of your own skills, proving yourself at Chaos Castle should give you some clarity. I have a quest for you. One through which you can earn the items you'll need in Chaos Castle.... Will you accept? (All characters: Master Level)": "Aku yakin kau punya jejak panjang monster yang telah dikalahkan di belakangmu. Namun, kemampuan tiap pengembara sangat berbeda-beda. Jika kau belum yakin dengan kemampuanmu sendiri, membuktikan dirimu di Chaos Castle seharusnya memberimu gambaran. Aku punya misi untukmu. Misi yang memberimu item-item yang kau butuhkan di Chaos Castle.... Maukah kau menerima? (Semua karakter: Master Level)", "I'm too busy to help right now.": "Aku terlalu sibuk untuk membantu sekarang.", "Ice Walkers are attacking and weakening the barrier that was formed to separate La Cleon and Devias from one another. Go to La Cleon and defeat 120 Ice Walkers. Come see me once that's done to receive a Devil's Invitation + 6 as a reward. They are strong foes, and you should hunt them with the help of others.": "Ice Walkers menyerang dan melemahkan penghalang yang dibentuk untuk memisahkan La Cleon dan Devias satu sama lain. Pergilah ke La Cleon dan kalahkan 120 Ice Walkers. Temui aku setelah selesai untuk menerima Devil's Invitation + 6 sebagai hadiah. Mereka musuh yang kuat, sebaiknya kau berburu dengan bantuan orang lain.", "If you are an Agility Elf, whose priority is defense, you can equip a weapon and use its skills. If you are an Energy Elf, whose priority is wizardry, you can purchase orbs to learn skills.": "Jika kau adalah Agility Elf, yang mengutamakan pertahanan, kau bisa memasang senjata dan menggunakan skill-skillnya. Jika kau adalah Energy Elf, yang mengutamakan sihir, kau bisa membeli orb untuk mempelajari skill.", "If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.": "Jika kau memakai senjata yang dipenuhi skill, kau bisa mengaktifkan skill itu dengan memindahkannya ke jendela Skill.", "If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.": "Jika kau memakai senjata yang dipenuhi skill, kau bisa
@B 26pu 24000
 mengaktifkan skill itu dengan memindahkannya ke jendela Skill.;Kau lihat slot bernomor di tengah bawah layar? Klik ikon yang dilingkari garis hijau, di sebelah kanan slot nomor lima.", "If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in 'Party off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in 'Request on' in the Chat window.": "Jika kau tidak ingin menerima permintaan party saat berburu, cukup ketik 'Party off' di jendela Chat. Untuk mulai menerima permintaan party lagi, ketik 'Request on' di jendela Chat.", "If you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy.": "Jika kau berada jauh dari kota atau terpojok saat berburu, Town Portal Scroll bisa sangat berguna.", "If you leave the gens, your contribution will be reset.;Do you still wish to leave?": "Jika kau meninggalkan gens, kontribusimu akan direset.;Apakah kau tetap ingin keluar?", "If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.": "Jika kau ingin tahu kapan kau bisa masuk, cukup arahkan mouse-mu ke Armor of Guardsman. Jika kau ingin masuk, cukup klik kanan pada armor itu pada waktu yang ditentukan. Temui aku saat kau punya waktu, dan aku akan memberimu misi yang akan memberimu item yang dibutuhkan untuk memasuki event.", "Illusion Spells, the foundation of Illusion Sorcery, was discovered by an Archaeologist named Mirage. Mirage found the spells' power to be too dangerous and sealed it. His partner Lev, however, stole the spells to brainwash people and establish Illusion Sorcery. Illusion Sorcery gradually grew larger and brought chaos to the continent.": "Illusion Spells, fondasi Illusion Sorcery, ditemukan oleh seorang Arkeolog bernama Mirage. Mirage mendapati kekuatan mantra itu terlalu berbahaya dan menyegelnya. Namun, rekannya Lev mencuri mantra itu untuk mencuci otak orang dan mendirikan Illusion Sorcery. Illusion Sorcery lambat laun makin besar dan membawa kekacauan ke benua.", "Illusion Temple Adaptation (1)": "Adaptasi Illusion Temple (1)", "Illusion Temple Adaptation (2)": "Adaptasi Illusion Temple (2)", "Illusion Temple Adaptation (3)": "Adaptasi Illusion Temple (3)", "Illusion Temple Challenge (1)": "Tantangan Illusion Temple (1)", "Illusion Temple Challenge (2)": "Tantangan Illusion Temple (2)", "Illusion Temple Challenge (3)": "Tantangan Illusion Temple (3)", "Illusion Temple is a place where you can acquire items and equipment for fast growth. If you wish to possess such items and equipment for yourself, inquire with the Shadow Phantom Soldier about Illusion Temple.": "Illusion Temple adalah tempat di mana kau bisa memperoleh item dan perlengkapan untuk pertumbuhan cepat. Jika kau ingin memiliki item dan perlengkapan seperti itu, tanyakan pada Shadow Phantom Soldier tentang Illusion Temple.", "Illusion Temple is a place where you can find both wealth and fame. If you take the temple challenge, you might acquire something essential for your training. Would you like to take the challenge? (All characters: Level 271-320)": "Illusion Temple adalah tempat di mana kau bisa menemukan kekayaan sekaligus ketenaran. (Karakter dasar: Level 81-130, Karakter lanjutan: Level 61-110)", "In MU, it's possible to combine different items to create new ones. In fact, trying out different combinations of items adds a whole new dimension to MU.;Whom should you seek out in order to combine items?": "Di MU, kau bisa menggabungkan item-item berbeda untuk menciptakan item baru. Sebenarnya, mencoba berbagai kombinasi item menambah dimensi baru sepenuhnya ke MU.;Kepada siapa kau harus mencari untuk menggabung item?", "In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination. Discovering areas that are right for your level and hunting there can also be very fun.": "Di dunia MU, kau bisa menggunakan tombol M untuk bepergian dengan mudah, asalkan levelmu cukup tinggi dan kau punya cukup uang untuk tujuan itu. Menemukan area yang sesuai dengan levelmu dan berburu di sana juga bisa sangat menyenangkan.", "Inland Supply Route!": "Rute Pasokan Darat!", "Iron Riders have been launching guerilla attacks against our forces stationed throughout Kanturu Ruins. Eliminate these Iron Riders and relieve the stress of our gens members.": "Iron Riders telah melancarkan serangan gerilya terhadap pasukan kami yang ditempatkan di seluruh Kanturu Ruins. Lenyapkan Iron Riders ini dan hilangkan beban anggota gens kita.", "Is it time for me to return to the Dungeon?": "Apakah sudah waktunya aku kembali ke Dungeon?", "Is the bond of your Blood Castle party still strong? If not, I suggest you return to Blood Castle to strengthen it. I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 231-280, Advanced character: Level 211-260)": "Apakah ikatan party Blood Castle-mu masih kuat? Jika tidak, saranku kembalilah ke Blood Castle untuk memperkuatnya. Aku punya misi yang akan memberimu item yang kau butuhkan untuk memasuki Blood Castle. Maukah kau menerima misi ini? (Karakter dasar: Level 231-280, Karakter lanjutan: Level 211-260)", "Is there anything I need to be cautious of?": "Apakah ada yang perlu aku waspadai?", "Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?": "Apakah ada yang perlu aku ketahui tentang Illusion Temple?", "Is there anything I should know about Devil Square?": "Apakah ada yang perlu aku ketahui tentang Devil Square?", "It all makes sense now.": "Semuanya jadi masuk akal sekarang.", "It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.": "Itu tidak masalah bagi para pengembara, tapi kau harus berhati-hati saat membunuh seorang guardsman korup. Guardsman korup akan meledak dan bahkan bisa mendorongmu jatuh dari arena. Jika ini terjadi, kau akan didiskualifikasi.", "It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?": "Memang mudah untuk masuk. Sebenarnya, event ini mencakup apa?", "It seems Cursed Liches are tormenting the residents of Elveland with their dark spells and curses. Hunt down 40 of those Cursed Liches, and I'll give you a Devil's Invitation +1 as a reward. I suggest you work with others for faster results.": "Sepertinya Cursed Liches menyiksa penduduk Elveland dengan mantra gelap dan kutukan mereka. Buru 40 Cursed Liches itu, dan aku akan memberimu Devil's Invitation +1 sebagai hadiah. Saranku bekerjalah dengan orang lain untuk hasil yang lebih cepat.", "It seems you have mighty warriors who are willing to fight at your side. Facing the challenges of Blood Castle together will certainly strengthen your bond with your comrades. Will you return to Blood Castle and carry out another quest of Archangel? (All characters: Master Level)": "Sepertinya kau memiliki prajurit perkasa yang bersedia bertempur di sisimu. Menghadapi tantangan Blood Castle bersama pasti akan mempererat ikatanmu dengan rekan-rekanmu. Maukah kau kembali ke Blood Castle dan menjalankan misi Archangel lainnya? (Semua karakter: Master Level)", "It seems you have mighty warriors who are willing to fight at your side. Facing the challenges of Blood Castle together will certainly strengthen your bond with your comrades. Will you return to Blood Castle and carry out another quest of Archangel? (Basic character: Level 131-180, Advanced character: Level 111-160)": "Sepertinya kau memiliki prajurit perkasa yang bersedia bertempur di sisimu. #ifndef direct_glActiveTexture
#define push_glActiveTexture(texture) { \
    glActiveTexture_PACKED *packed_data = malloc(sizeof(glActiveTexture_PACKED)); \
    packed_data->format = glActiveTexture_FORMAT; \
    packed_data->func = gl4es_glActiveTexture; \
    packed_data->args.a1 = (GLenum)texture; \
    glPushCall((void *)packed_data); \
}
#endif
#ifndef direct_glAlphaFunc
#define push_glAlphaFunc(func, ref) { \
    glAlphaFunc_PACKED *packed_data = malloc(sizeof(glAlphaFunc_PACKED)); \
    packed_data->format = glAlphaFunc_FORMAT; \
    packed_data->func = gl4es_glAlphaFunc; \
    packed_data->args.a1 = (GLenum)func; \
    packed_data->args.a2 = (GLclampf)ref; \
    glPushCall((void *)packed_data); \
}

    packed_data->func = gl4es_glVertexPointer; \
    packed_data->args.a1 = (GLint)size; \
    packed_data->args.a2 = (GLenum)type; \
    packed_data->args.a3 = (GLsizei)stride; \
    packed_data->args.a4 = (GLvoid *)pointer; \
    glPushCall((void *)packed_data); \
}
#endif
#ifndef direct_glViewport
#define push_glViewport(x, y, width, height) { \
    glViewport_PACKED *packed_data = malloc(sizeof(glViewport_PACKED)); \
    packed_data->format = glViewport_FORMAT; \
    packed_data->func = gl4es_glViewport; \
    packed_data->args.a1 = (GLint)x; \
    packed_data->args.a2 = (GLint)y; \
    packed_data->args.a3 = (GLsizei)width; \
    packed_data->args.a4 = (GLsizei)height; \
    glPushCall((void *)packed_data); \
}
#endif
#endif
